description: Die in the Dungeon: CLASSIC (Alarts/ATICO 2021, native Linux, itch.io v1.6.2f)
long: Die in the Dungeon: CLASSIC is a dice-based roguelike dungeon crawler originally created for the Brackeys Game Jam. Players place and combine dice on a board to attack, defend, and trigger effects as they descend through procedurally arranged encounters. The free prototype emphasizes deck-building-style synergy with dice instead of cards.
